Each sword independently rolls damage within the displayed range and combined damage must defeat the enemy.

The creator risks another fight and succeeds while protecting an earned opal.
Choose bucket fill over mining efficiency and cooking speed to improve early cavern progression.
Run away when victory requires near-maximum damage rolls on every sword.

Later Bravery rounds can award multipliers but progression tends to stall around the low fifties.
Ordinary Bravery rewards eventually face diminishing returns while rare multipliers remain valuable.
The accumulated reward multiplier increases each day.
Run Bravery daily if practical and avoid letting the reward multiplier sit much above three because of diminishing returns.
The creator temporarily used Bell for opal grinding.
Prioritize Bell-cleaning improvements rather than resetting merely to exploit double-level rings.
Assign available bucket production to Gold Dust for the damage-scaling upgrade.
Prioritize the experience needed for three simultaneous gods over modest immediate schematic progress.
The shop offers Conjuror points and doubled experience as optional cavern acceleration.
Avoid buying opals and generally save gems for better upgrades instead of bypassing cavern time gates.
Start Hole progression as soon as possible because its upgrades are valuable.
Unlock Island Expeditions earlier than demonstrated to benefit from its time-gated progression sooner.
Reasonable progress does not require perfect efficiency or heavy spending.
Waiting for lab progression is unnecessary because active progression can continue without its full kill multiplier.
Always choose the Legacy companion pool.
Ram would be a major convenience upgrade for this account.
Accumulated Dementia Bars allow beginning Dementia armor progression.
Progress from Amarok to Dementia to Void after unlocking the relevant Smithy system.
Stay in Amarok gear if the later set system is not unlocked.
Amarok's set bonus provides a powerful accuracy and defense multiplier.
Prioritize Copper for mining and chopping efficiency then Iron and Gold when feasible.
Efaunt gear is not yet unlocked and the account has not accumulated enough keys.
Salt shortages make refreshed refinery-material samples necessary.

Place everyone's traps through Beast Master to improve critter yield.
Farm Naked Moleos to craft Nature Traps.
Characters still receive trapping experience when their traps are placed through Trapper Drone.
Upgrade traps earlier rather than neglecting them until this stage.
Shiny quantity does not scale with trap duration so use frequent twenty-minute shiny traps for faster accumulation.

Use Shiny Snitch when shiny chance is already high enough to offset its penalty.
A Fleeter and Targeter setup improves spice production and supports faster kitchens.
Focus on Eggs for cooking speed before Diamond Chef unlocks.
Pursue Mercenary for early battles and Refiller pets for the later setup.
Build toward two Refillers with Burger as tank and Rattler as damage and Monolith as stall and Looter for random effects.
Improve new-pet chances to make the planned team easier to unlock.
Gold Relic grows samples daily up to its duration cap and resets growth when a new sample is taken.
Assign one ship to Desert for gold and one to Safari for artifacts.
Save gold for more captains while prioritizing inexpensive ship-speed upgrades over loot value.
Use cheap attempts and wait for a guaranteed unlock option when it appears.
Focus trades experience rate for more divinity points and unlocks at level ten.
Linking Harriep with the lab printer bonus gives sixfold output and Harriep also improves money.
Unlock Goat to progress divinity and lab simultaneously.
Switch eligible characters to Focus while prioritizing the next god unlocks.
Avoid expensive uncertain attempts and wait for guaranteed large attempts instead.
Noob Sect and the lab kill bonus combine for fourfold kills in the demonstrated setup.
Rift Six unlocks daily automatic trap claims allowing low-maintenance twenty-hour trap setups.
Unlock Equinox and Island Expeditions before continuing armor and sample preparation.
Elemental Sorcerer is better for the planned AFK push.
Check the combat preset when AFK kills appear unexpectedly low.
Use candy for most of a portal requirement then finish a small remainder actively to save candy.
Before sleeping finish nearly completed portals with candy so the full overnight claim advances the next map.
If Divine Knight lacks boss damage park it for keys and push Elemental Sorcerer while developing stamps.
Elemental Sorcerer is strong for card farming and eventually uses damage and drop-rate bonuses.
The creator spends candy to reach the map needed for Equinox.
Farm the mirror near Bloodbones and hold it to enter Equinox Valley then unlock dreams for map access.
The first dream requires twenty distinct greenstacks.
Ten million of one item forms a greenstack and provides damage when the relevant lab bonus is unlocked.
Completing dreams unlocks additional Equinox upgrades.
Each full bar permits one upgrade level so unlock Equinox early even before completing its first challenge.
Upgrading Equinox Dreams opens more clouds and challenge opportunities.
Liquid Investment turns overflowing liquids into capacity and rate upgrades instead of wasting capped generation.
Slow Roast Wiz increases tower damage while the current wave remains undefeated.
Push waves ahead for worship points and hold enemies while damage ramps; clearing the relevant wave resets the bonus.
Liquid Investment and Slow Roast Wiz are two major reasons to unlock Equinox early.
Ignore the summoning boss stone until World Six.
Check Equinox periodically and upgrade Dreams while later skill resources unlock for equipment crafting.
Craft and register Copper first for mining and chopping efficiency.
Iron set grants class experience.
Gold set increases coins dropped by monsters.
Complete Platinum if possible for fishing and catching efficiency before sampling.
Craft prerequisite Copper and Iron pieces then upgrade them through the higher sets.
Temporarily print Platinum and fill forge slots to supply the equipment crafting session.
Buy World Five forge barrels for multibar chance while producing required bars.
Run barrels during early progression although endgame production may consume them too quickly to maintain conveniently.
Visit Pogg after reaching sufficient divinity to obtain the strong Multitool Stamp.
Upgrade Amarok with available stones for better samples because registered set bonuses do not require wearing Copper.
Avoid neglecting tools and trapping and worship while pushing worlds.
Use movement-based action resets to accelerate low-level skilling if willing to perform the repetitive inputs.

Portal farming quickly produces Goblin cards and materials due to the accessible early-world drop rates.
Use the same farming session to raise Goblin and Jungle Log and Boa vials to level four.
The short Goblin farm provides an additional card-drop bonus.
Use the slower World Six progression period to equip tools and catch up neglected skills on other characters.
Plan to farm Snelbie and Sir Stache cards for card-drop improvements.
Keep damage in the farming build because higher portal kills improve the farm.
Complete the required Iron tool alongside armor to register the set.
Gold gear also supports the later Goldric quest line.

Interact with the Smithy helmet while wearing the full required set before upgrading or removing its pieces.
Woodular Circles are worth farming for Amarok's strong set bonus especially without buying the gem alternative.

Farm Butterflies with Forest Fibers and Distilled Water for upgraded tools.
Use short candy claims to gather tool materials when active farming becomes too slow.
Craft Platinum net and rod and axe and pickaxe to improve all skill samples.
Craft the skill-efficiency boots when practical because they materially help skill setups.
The creator receives some gems and chooses villager-experience upgrades over the considered multikill purchase.
Fungi grants triple bits but no gaming experience.
Bonsai gains a stronger evolution multiplier than ordinary plants.
Unlocking new plant types improves the Logbook multiplier.
Improve base bit production and sprout capacity while approaching level twenty for more unlocks.
Save fertilizer for later key pushes rather than using it impatiently during the early stage.
Eventually max the Poop card for a crystal-spawn build.
Farm Golden Plops and craft Crow's Nest as part of the Platinum preparation.
Crafting and equipping the upgrade adds Slab progress and raises displayed damage.
The completed early sets provide broad combat and skilling bonuses.
Copper and Platinum are the most important immediate sets for samples.
Keep Gold armor for Goldric quests and pass unused Platinum gear to the beginner progression character.
The demonstrated Platinum tool requires Bloaches and bars.
After completing sampling equipment unlock Island Expeditions before taking samples.
Use improved fishing gear and a short candy claim to reach the Island Expeditions level requirement.
Island fishing adds Scaly Fish and Sand Sharks and Krakens and another fish type.
Daily bottles unlock islands and the quest line increases bottle generation.
Shimmer provides weekly tasks and permanent upgrades such as skill efficiency.
Seasalt adds fish with excellent fishing experience.
Crystal Island contains giant crystal monsters that drop candy but is not an immediate priority.
Rando guarantees a weekly random event.
Trash Island supplies daily garbage that can be traded for rewards.
Choose Shimmer and Trash before Seasalt because stamps and skill efficiency are more immediately useful.
Trash offers stamps for fishing efficiency and printer sample size and drop rate and all stats.
Trash also offers bribes and a name tag and a star talent granting damage based on collected trash.
Collect trash daily and prioritize all stamps before investing heavily in extra garbage or bottles.
Use the dummy to test and compare damage setups.
Weekly tasks award wisps but some tasks make the maximum difficult or impossible.
The creator accepts seven wisps and chooses between a rare star-book attempt and permanent skill efficiency.
The rare star book grants all stats based on damage dealt to the dummy.
Prioritize Shimmer skill efficiency over the uncertain book attempt.
A later sailing artifact multiplies Shimmer bonuses and makes accumulated skill efficiency extremely strong.
Complete the bottle-rate quest to accelerate unlocking every island.
Fractal accumulates bonuses from characters spending AFK time doing nothing.
Fractal includes a strong sneaking bonus and a chance to obtain Nothing Trophy.
The creator still lacks Nothing Trophy despite extensive nothing time and candy use.
After Shimmer and Trash unlock Seasalt then Crystal then Fractal then Rando.
Fractal's strong sneaking bonus makes it preferable to Rando for this progression route.
